texts.orig: When you first hear your manager’s idea, avoid reacting with a quick yes or no. Especially if you think it’s a terrible idea. Instead, start by getting curious. Force yourself to ask at least three questions. For example: What does my manager see that I don’t see? Am I too in the weeds? Am I afraid of shaking things up and doing something risky? Am I missing some important broader context?
